reviews.title: Shame on WePlay — Unfair Account Ban and Failure to Control Abusive Players
reviews.text:
Honestly, shame on WePlay for handling this situation so poorly. I genuinely don’t understand what your moderation team is doing or how you are managing the platform. You seem to have no idea what is actually happening inside your own games, yet you are banning accounts without properly understanding the situation.

While playing on WePlay, I encountered players who showed absolutely no respect for others. They were using abusive language, vulgar expressions, and inappropriate 18+ words during the game. Their behavior was disgusting and completely unacceptable.

My question is simple: Where is your moderation team when these things are happening? Do you even monitor what is going on in your games? How can you allow players to behave this way while apparently taking action against accounts without properly investigating the circumstances?

Do the people responsible for managing WePlay have any common sense about fairness? Is this the kind of behavior WePlay encourages in its community? How can you allow people to disrespect and verbally abuse other players while failing to maintain a decent gaming environment?

What makes this even more frustrating is that my account has been banned, and I still don’t understand why. Before taking such serious action, shouldn’t your team investigate the situation, review the available evidence, and identify who was actually behaving inappropriately? Banning an account without a clear explanation is unacceptable.

reviews.title: WePlay’s Banning Policy
reviews.text:
I used the WePlay app expecting fair and fun gameplay, but I’m disappointed with how the account banning policy is handled.

The biggest issue is that accounts seem to be banned without clear or valid reasons. When someone abuses or harasses other players, they should be held accountable — and those accounts should be reviewed or banned first. Instead, my account was banned even though I was reacting to abusive behavior.

A responsible platform should:

🔹 Clearly explain why an account is banned
🔹 Give warnings or transparent evidence before taking action
🔹 Treat all users fairly and equally
🔹 Hold abusers accountable, not just reactive users

Right now, the ban system feels one-sided and unfair, and it needs improvement. A competitive social app should protect users and enforce rules consistently — not ban people without reason or explanation.

Please revisit your banning policy and improve transparency. Players deserve to know the why behind the action.
